definition: to produce less garbage
example: Bringing reusable bags is a simple way to reduce waste when shopping.

definition: to process used materials so they can be used again
example: In BC, you can return empty bottles and cans to a recycling depot and get your deposit back.

definition: to turn food scraps and yard waste into natural fertilizer
vi: ủ phân hữu cơ (từ rác thực phẩm, lá cây)
example: Our building started a program to compost food scraps in green bins.

definition: plastic items, like straws and bags, meant to be used once and thrown away
example: Many Canadian cities have moved to ban single-use plastics such as checkout bags and straws.

definition: the amount of greenhouse gases a person or activity produces
vi: lượng khí thải carbon (dấu chân carbon)
example: Cycling to work instead of driving can greatly lower your carbon footprint.

definition: long-term changes in the Earth's weather, mainly caused by human activity
example: Scientists say climate change is making BC's wildfire seasons longer.

definition: gases such as carbon dioxide released into the air that warm the planet
example: The province has set targets to cut greenhouse gas emissions over the next decade.

definition: energy from sources that do not run out, like sun, wind and water
example: Most of BC's electricity already comes from renewable energy such as hydro power.

definition: using less energy to do the same job
example: Replacing old windows with energy-efficient ones cut our heating bill by a third.

definition: to use something carefully so that it is not wasted
vi: tiết kiệm, sử dụng tiết kiệm (nước, điện, tài nguyên)
example: During the drought, residents were asked to conserve water by limiting lawn watering.

definition: a large fire that spreads quickly through forests or grasslands
example: Wildfire smoke made the air quality in Kelowna very poor last August.

definition: a long period with little or no rain
example: The drought forced farmers in the Fraser Valley to cut back on irrigation.

definition: how clean or polluted the air is
example: An air quality warning was issued because of smoke from nearby fires.

definition: able to continue for a long time without harming the environment
example: The city is promoting public transit and cycling as more sustainable ways to get around.

definition: not harmful to the environment
example: The café only uses eco-friendly cups made from recycled paper.

definition: over a long period of time; eventually
example: Electric cars cost more at first, but they save money in the long run.
collocations: pay off in the long run

definition: to help people know more about a problem
example: The school held an Earth Day event to raise awareness about ocean plastic.

definition: to do something to deal with a problem
example: Residents urged the council to take action on the polluted creek.

definition: wild animals and birds living in their natural environment
vi: động vật hoang dã, đời sống hoang dã
example: Hikers are reminded not to feed wildlife, including bears and raccoons.

definition: harmful substances in air, water or land
example: Noise pollution from the new highway is a major complaint in the area.

definition: a car that runs on electricity instead of gas
example: Before you buy an electric vehicle, check whether any government rebates are available.

definition: a period of unusually hot weather
example: During the 2021 heat wave, temperatures in Lytton reached nearly 50 degrees.

definition: types of animals or plants that may soon disappear completely
vi: các loài có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng
example: Southern resident killer whales are an endangered species protected by law.

definition: to stop using something gradually over a period of time
example: The city plans to phase out plastic bags over the next two years.

definition: unusual and severe weather such as floods, storms or heat
example: Extreme weather such as atmospheric rivers has damaged highways across BC.

definition: rubbish such as wrappers and cans left on the ground in a public place; also, to leave rubbish like this
vi: rác vứt bừa bãi; xả rác
example: Volunteers picked up bags of litter along the beach after the long weekend.

definition: able to be used more than once
example: Many cafés in Victoria give a small discount if you bring a reusable cup.

definition: an area of grass, trees or plants in a town or city, such as a park
example: The new condo towers should include more green space for families who don't have a yard.

definition: a situation in which a large amount of water covers land that is usually dry
example: Heavy rain caused flooding on several roads in the Fraser Valley, so drivers had to take long detours.

definition: the regular service of picking up household waste from homes and businesses
example: Garbage collection in our neighbourhood is delayed by one day because of the holiday.

definition: to put young trees in the ground so that they grow
example: Our strata council asked residents to help plant trees along the back fence this spring.

definition: to use less electricity, gas or fuel
example: We save energy by turning down the heat at night and using LED bulbs.

definition: to start living or working in a way that is better for the environment
vi: sống xanh, chuyển sang thân thiện với môi trường
example: Our office decided to go green by switching to paperless invoices.

definition: to remove dirt, rubbish or pollution from a place
example: Dozens of neighbours came out to clean up the creek before the salmon returned.

definition: water that is clean and safe for people to drink
example: The town issued a boil-water notice after its drinking water was affected by the storm.

definition: an official instruction telling people they must leave an area because it is dangerous
example: When the wildfire moved closer, the regional district issued an evacuation order for the whole valley.

definition: a storm in which the main danger is very strong wind
example: A fall windstorm knocked down trees and left thousands of homes on Vancouver Island without power.

definition: the place where an animal or plant normally lives and grows
example: The wetlands are a natural habitat for many birds, so the city decided not to build there.

definition: the work of cutting down trees for wood
example: Some residents support logging because it creates jobs, while others want the forest protected.

definition: all the plants, animals and other living things in an area and the way they affect each other
example: Experts warn that the oil spill could damage the entire coastal ecosystem.

definition: a large area where rubbish is buried under the ground
example: Food waste that ends up in the landfill produces methane as it breaks down.
collocations: keep waste out of the landfill

definition: small pieces of food that are left over or thrown away, such as peels and leftovers
vi: rác thực phẩm, thức ăn thừa
example: In our building, food scraps go in the green bin instead of the regular garbage.

definition: fuels such as coal, oil and gas that come from the remains of plants and animals
example: Many families are looking for ways to depend less on fossil fuels for heating and transportation.

definition: an electric device that moves heat to warm a building in winter and can also cool it in summer
vi: máy bơm nhiệt (sưởi và làm mát)
example: We replaced our old gas furnace with a heat pump, and our home stays cool during heat waves too.

definition: flat pieces of equipment that use sunlight to make electricity
vi: tấm pin năng lượng mặt trời
example: Our neighbours put solar panels on their roof, and they say their electricity bills went down.

definition: to not be used, so that something useful is lost or thrown away
example: The community fridge makes sure that extra groceries don't go to waste.
collocations: hate to see it go to waste

definition: to get rid of something, especially in a safe or correct way
example: Please dispose of old paint and batteries at the recycling depot, not in your garbage bin.

definition: poisonous and harmful to people, animals or the environment
example: Burning plastic releases toxic smoke, so you should never put it in a backyard fire pit.

definition: a large amount of earth and rocks that suddenly falls down a hill or mountain
example: The highway was closed for days after a landslide covered the road near Hope.

definition: an accident in which oil escapes into the sea or onto land
example: Coastal communities worry about the impact an oil spill would have on fishing and tourism.

definition: a long system of pipes used for carrying oil, gas or water over long distances
example: The proposed pipeline has divided the town between those who want jobs and those who fear spills.

definition: the effect that an activity or project has on the natural world
example: Before approving the new mine, the province studied its environmental impact on nearby rivers.

definition: using more of something than is necessary, or not using it carefully
example: Leaving the sprinklers on during a rainstorm is very wasteful.

definition: a situation in which there is not enough water for people's needs
example: After a dry summer, some Island communities faced a water shortage and asked residents to stop watering lawns.

definition: to keep something in its original state and protect it from harm or change
example: Local groups are raising money to preserve the forest for future generations.

definition: a mixture of smoke, gases and fog that makes the air dirty, especially in cities
example: On hot, still days, a layer of smog can sit over the valley and make it hard to see the mountains.

definition: the cutting down of trees over a large area
example: Deforestation on steep slopes can make landslides more likely after heavy rain.

definition: a forest that has existed for a very long time without major disturbance, with very large, old trees
example: Protesters camped in the woods to stop the logging of old-growth forest on Vancouver Island.

definition: the variety of plants and animals living in a particular area
example: Planting native flowers in your garden can increase local biodiversity.

definition: waste that is dangerous to people or the environment, such as chemicals, batteries and paint
example: The city holds special collection days for hazardous waste like propane tanks and pesticides.

definition: to make something dirty, polluted or harmful by adding a dangerous substance
vi: làm ô nhiễm, làm nhiễm bẩn
example: Chemicals from the old factory may have contaminated the soil near the river.

definition: a long, narrow band of very moist air that can bring days of heavy rain
vi: sông khí quyển (dải hơi ẩm gây mưa lớn kéo dài)
example: Forecasters warned that an atmospheric river would bring heavy rain to the South Coast this weekend.

definition: an area of land from which all the rain and streams flow into one river or lake
example: Hiking is not allowed in that area because it is part of the city's drinking water watershed.

definition: the time each year when large numbers of salmon swim up rivers to lay eggs
vi: mùa cá hồi di cư ngược dòng
example: Families gather by the river in the fall to watch the salmon run.

definition: a plant or animal that is brought to a new area and spreads quickly, harming local wildlife
example: Volunteers spent the morning pulling out Himalayan blackberry, an invasive species that crowds out native plants.

definition: the gradual increase in the height of the ocean, mainly caused by climate change
example: Low-lying areas like Richmond are planning higher dikes because of rising sea levels.
collocations: the threat of rising sea levels

definition: a very large mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain or valley
example: Scientists say many glaciers in the Coast Mountains are shrinking every year.

definition: no longer existing because all members of the species have died
example: Without protection, some local frog populations could become extinct within our lifetime.

definition: producing or using only small amounts of carbon dioxide
example: The developer promised a low-carbon building with a heat pump and plenty of bike storage.

definition: the layer formed by the branches and leaves of trees, seen from above
vi: tán cây (độ che phủ của cây xanh)
example: Neighbourhoods with a thick tree canopy stay several degrees cooler during a heat wave.

definition: the amount of energy that is used by a person, building, device or country
example: Smart thermostats can help households track and lower their energy consumption.

definition: more plastic, paper or boxes around a product than are really needed
vi: bao bì quá mức, đóng gói thừa thãi
example: I emailed the company to complain about the excessive packaging on a tiny online order.

definition: to make something harmful or unpleasant less serious or severe
example: The city is planting more trees to mitigate the effects of extreme heat.

definition: to control or limit something, especially something harmful
example: The council hopes the new bus routes will help curb traffic and pollution downtown.

definition: causing harm or damage
example: Some residents argue that the new resort would be detrimental to the local wildlife.

definition: impossible to change back to the way it was before
example: Scientists warn that some damage to the ocean may be irreversible if we wait too long to act.

definition: the uncontrolled spread of a city and its suburbs into the countryside
vi: sự mở rộng đô thị tràn lan
example: Many people in the valley are worried that urban sprawl is replacing farmland with subdivisions.
